title: the measurement behind the discovery pivot is stale or no longer adds up
evidence: newest account-level reach attribution 9.3h ago: non-follower=0 follower=2 total=2 -- the newest account-level reach attribution is 9.3h old (bound 6h). Producer: Growth::MetricsCollector#fetch_reach_attribution, hourly via growth:snapshot_followers, BEST-EFFORT by design (a failed insights call is logged once and stored as NULL). The pivot's justification -- that non-follower reach is a measured zero, so no content lever can move followers -- is only as good as this row: stale, it is a claim about the past; a missing or non-reconciling breakdown makes it a MISSING DIMENSION rather than a measured zero.
